lines.text:
You see those stairs there?
The captain’s quarters are up there.\c
He can teach you this cool [VAR COLOR(0006)]Secret Technique[VAR COLOR(0000)]
if you ask him. He’s really famous for it!
Though...he looked pretty done in\nby seasickness when I saw him.
Hey, before you go to meet him, how about\nI take a look to see how well you’ve been\r\nraising your Pokémon, huh?
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Wow, [VAR TRNAME(0000)].\nYou... You’ve gotten pretty strong.
Oh, uh, nothing! That’s cool!\c\nAnyway, go meet the captain and have him show\nyou his [VAR COLOR(0006)]Secret Technique[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
